title: Dough Guy 72-Hour Cold-Ferment Neapolitan/NY Pizza Dough
originalTitle: Dough Guy 72-Hour Cold-Ferment Neapolitan/NY Pizza Dough
ingredients: 500g Tipo 00 flour or high-protein bread flour (100%)
instructions: Dissolve instant yeast in the cold water, add the flour, and mix until roughly combined; autolyse (rest) covered for 20 minutes.
Add the sea salt and olive oil, kneading for 6–8 minutes (or performing 3 sets of stretch-and-folds 20 minutes apart) until the dough is smooth and passes the windowpane test.
Bulk ferment at room temperature for 1 hour, then divide into three 280g dough balls, place in lightly oiled lidded containers, and cold-ferment in the refrigerator (38–40°F) for 24 to 72 hours.

Remove dough balls from the fridge 2–3 hours before baking to reach room temperature, stretch by hand (preserving the airy cornicione rim), top, and bake on a preheated steel/stone at maximum oven heat (500–550°F).
